appPage.title: Android app
appPage.noRelease: No release has been published yet.
appPage.unavailable: Could not check the latest version. Find it on the releases page below.
appPage.install1: Tap Download on your phone. If the browser warns about this type of file, choose to download it anyway.
appPage.install2: Open the file from the browser's notification or from your Downloads.
appPage.install3: If Android says it cannot install from this source, tap Settings, turn on “Allow from this source” for your browser and go back.
appPage.protectBody: The app is not on Google Play, so Play Protect does not know its developer and may warn you or offer to scan it. If you trust this site, open “More details” and choose “Install anyway”. The wording differs from phone to phone.
appPage.updatesBody: The app does not update itself. To update, come back here, download the new version and install it over the old one. Your sign-in, settings and songs stay.
appPage.debugBody: A debug build is a separate app (com.erkantaylan.listenalong.debug), so both can be installed side by side. They do not share a sign-in or settings: sign in to this one on its own.
appPage.pendingNote: Your account is waiting for approval. You can install the app and sign in now; it can use the library once your account is approved.
appPage.connectSignIn: Open the app and tap “Sign in”. Use the same account as on this website; no token needed.

tokens.introAfter: command-line tool and its downloaders (la worker) use the library as you. Uploads are credited to your name. Make one per computer and revoke it when you stop using it.
